supportedScope: verified official Streamable HTTP Remote MCP connections

changes.toolDeadline: Remote MCP calls have a bounded 30 second default with a 10ms to 120s validated range for qualification
changes.ambiguousReplay: same semantic JSON call is blocked in the current Run even when object key order changes
changes.transportRecovery: failed list/call closes and discards the dead client before a later read reconnects
changes.refreshSerialization: concurrent expired credential requests share one refresh and the rotated token
changes.reauth: invalid_grant removes tokens while preserving reusable registration metadata

existingFlows: Linear DCR OAuth tools/list and read

boundaries: a timed-out or transport-failed write is not reported as success or confirmed failure
the underlying late remote work cannot be cancelled by Promise timeout alone, so the effect remains explicitly unknown
ambiguous replay blocking is scoped to the live tool instance; restart recovery continues to rely on canonical interrupted receipts and no automatic replay
production account writes were not exercised
nonGoals: automatic replay of idempotent or non-idempotent writes
